message: No detected untrusted source handling: HTTP requests to the SIGE API are made with plain requests.get() calls without any checksum verification, authentication headers, certificate pinning, or integrity checks on the retrieved data.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads both the Keras model (via `load_model`) and the scaler (via `pickle.load`) from plain file paths with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before use.

No detected label distribution validation: No label distribution or class balance check is performed before or during training; the only data quality step is an optional Hampel outlier filter on consumption values.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop or model code.
No detected differential privacy: The model is trained with a plain Keras fit() call and no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are present anywhere in the code; evaluation is limited to online prediction and retraining.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set, no signed or hashed evaluation data, and no independent metric computation; the model is continuously retrained and evaluated on streaming data without isolation.
No detected output bounds checks: The prediction result is used directly without any NaN guards, range/bounds checks, or sanity validation before being appended to the predictions list and published.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an LSTM time-series model processing numerical consumption data, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
